vulnerability.name: USN-5027-2
vulnerability.description: USN-5027-1 fixed a vulnerability in PEAR. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 16.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:   It was discovered that PEAR incorrectly handled symbolic links in archives.  A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code.

statements.status_notes: PEAR could be made to overwrite files as the administrator. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
